Place of Sands

One block of Far Rockaway, at the end of the A line. Eight pieces of sea glass, a window to set them in, and the sun on its way down. Ten minutes, give or take.

 

Controller moving a pointer? Hold the Menu button and Edge hands it to the game.

Place of sands

That's the Lenape name for this spit of sand, and it's still the most accurate thing anyone has called it.

The glass is in the window. The last A train is pulling out of Mott Avenue, the gulls are up over the dunes, and the light is doing the rest.
